name: Southern Palladium Limited
source: Southern Palladium Limited 2025 Annual Report to Shareholders, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 30 June 2025 (A$). FY2025 and FY2024 columns read from the audited statement published by the company; FY2023 and FY2022 rows retained from Yahoo Finance.

merge.key_alias: 20260920_1142: same statement, also published under the ticker the terminal resolves (SDL); source file SDL.JO

source_note: The company is pre-revenue, so the audited statement carries no revenue line and the revenue row is intentionally absent. Operating expenses are the audited expense lines summed: administration, employee benefits, share-based payments, impairment of the loan receivable and the share of the associate loss, which total 5,822,428 for FY2025 and 7,631,465 for FY2024. The only income is interest income of 1,042,940 (FY2025) and 906,188 (FY2024), carried as a negative net finance cost. The FY2024 expense lines were restated to the audited comparative. ROE, ROA and debt to equity for FY2025 are computed from the audited figures.
